_comment: Which names ./gpb blockcheck asks about, per app. Committed, like games.json: a blocked
service's hostnames are project data, not a property of one machine.
kind decides how a result is read, so it is not decoration:
primary  login, API, the pages people open. Small traffic. This is the part worth fixing.
bulk     downloads and media. Measured SEPARATELY and never assumed.
The bulk/primary split is the whole reason this file has a schema at all. On 2026-09-20
Steam's content CDNs turned out to resolve to caches INSIDE Vietnam that connect in 10-20 ms,
against 30-43 ms for the addresses a foreign resolver hands out - so for downloads the ISP's
answer is the better one, and routing them anywhere else would make every player slower while
fixing nothing. That was true of Steam. It is not a rule about any other app, which is why
every app here has to declare its own bulk names and have them measured.
The control name is added automatically and does not belong in an app's list.

control.why: nobody blocks it; proves the line and this tool are working
